aspect: The choices that cause it are usually forced ones
description: Which child to carry. Whether to open the door. Whether to give the name. These are not moral failures; they are impossible positions. The injury happens anyway.
energy_note: Judged by yourself, under rules that did not apply.

aspect: Exposure therapy is the wrong tool
description: Fear extinguishes with repeated safe exposure. Guilt and shame do not; repeating the memory without addressing the moral content can deepen them.
money_note: Cost of treatment that does not work first.

aspect: It attacks the identity rather than the nervous system
description: The conclusion is not 'the world is dangerous' but 'I am a certain kind of person'. That is not a symptom that medication reaches.

aspect: Conscripts carry it without having chosen any of it
description: Compulsory service means the acts were performed by someone who did not choose the war, the unit, the order or the year. The moral weight lands on them regardless.
energy_note: Conscripted into something you will answer for alone.

description: He was nineteen and he was told to keep the queue moving. He kept the queue moving. He is fifty-four and he has never told his wife about the woman with the blue bag, and he could not now say what he thinks he did wrong.
energy_note: Thirty-five years of an unexamined three seconds.
